prompts.ballistics:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas, a NEW combat VFX asset for Shiranui, SSS LIMITED.
Reference image: the attached approved character artwork is STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Do not redraw the character or weapon. Translate its black military, white halo, solid silver ammunition, storm of white light and smoky charcoal aesthetic into effects.
Create ONE transparent RGBA sprite sheet, exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, twelve equally sized square cells on a 1536x1152 canvas (384px per cell). No grid lines, numbers, text, background, ground, characters or weapons. Every effect remains fully within its cell with 28px clear padding. Never connect adjacent cells.
Row 1: four distinct sequential frames of an intense silver-white rifle muzzle flash, starting at cell x=0.28 y=0.5 and pointing exactly horizontally RIGHT. Phase 1 compact ignition, phase 2 razor white star-shaped jet, phase 3 jagged expanding silver flare with black smoke filaments, phase 4 wispy fading sparks. Detailed but legible at 80px.
Row 2: four distinct animation frames of a projectile flying horizontally RIGHT. A prominent solid pointed silver bullet at cell x=0.70 y=0.50, jacket/grooves in charcoal and polished silver, bright white core outline, LONG tapered lightning and spectral black smoke wake extending LEFT toward x=0.12, thin separated silver shards. Each frame has an evolving wake and distinct lightning branch shapes; keep the bullet tip at the same place. This is the visible ammunition, make it striking and substantial, not just a white line.
Row 3: four distinct sequential bullet impact frames centered at x=0.5,y=0.5, compact star flash followed by splintering silver shards and thin ink-black spectral tendrils, then dispersed fading particles. Use crisp silver-white hot edges against darker gunmetal inner structure. No colored flames, no orange, blue, purple, gold. High quality 2D painted anime RPG VFX, angular restrained military shapes, rich material contrast. Actual transparent background, soft alpha edges, no fake checkerboard.
prompts.rupture:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D anime RPG VFX animation atlas for Shiranui's single-target 30-round silver barrage. NEW EFFECT ONLY, NOT CHARACTER ART. Reference artwork supplies the monochrome gunmetal/silver/white spectral military aesthetic.
Make ONE genuinely transparent sprite sheet, precisely 4 columns and 3 rows = twelve equal square cells on a 1536 by 1152 image. All twelve frames centered at the same location in their cells. Critical: each frame occupies at most 75% of cell width and height, with completely empty 12.5% margins on ALL sides; nothing touching, no stray particles crossing cells, no labels, no grid, no character, no gun, no ground or backdrop.
Read frames left to right then next row. Author a coherent animation of a SINGLE TARGET SILVER-SPECTRAL RUPTURE. Frame 1 a slender broken silver halo and tiny central crack. Frame 2 the cracked halo charges with short lightning stitches. Frame 3 a brilliant central white slash with fine dark wisps. Frame 4 four angular silver spear shards puncture the halo outward. Frame 5 white-hot bright but hollow expanding impact with sharp radial silver shards and charcoal vapor. Frame 6 the most powerful burst, many detailed irregular silver fragments, broken halo segments and branching white electric filaments, transparent open gaps. Frame 7 sweeping outward fragment trails around a dark hollow middle. Frame 8 black spectral vapor wreath with silver streaks. Frame 9 fragmented shrinking luminous remnants. Frame 10 sparse scattered silver sparks and faint translucent wisps. Frame 11 much fainter drifting dust. Frame 12 only a few fading tiny silver flecks.
Dynamic changing silhouettes, distinct authored phases, not copies scaled. Color strictly silver-white, black and charcoal with polished metallic detail. Dramatic luxurious SSS-level impact, high contrast edges, restrained screen coverage, preserve visibility through open transparent gaps; no solid white disc, no orange or colored fire, no animals, no magical lettering. Painted 2D high-end game asset with soft genuine alpha edges.
prompts.dialogue:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game UI dialogue frame for SHIRANUI SSS LIMITED, an elegant cold monochrome spectral rifle commander. Reference image only informs art direction: silver-white halo, torn black military standards, gunmetal longcoat, polished silver ammunition. DO NOT depict the character or any text.
Transparent RGBA wide canvas 1536x384. Place ONE horizontal dialogue frame occupying x=24..1512, y=70..310. Its center area x=250..1286,y=90..290 must be a very dark opaque charcoal leather/black cloth surface, virtually empty and low contrast for readable live text. A thin solid detailed silver rail across the upper and lower edges, not a generic rectangle. Delicate milled gunmetal layered edges, small white specular highlights and fine engraved spectral ornament. Left end: a compact circular silver halo setting, torn black military cloth folds and a small polished ammunition emblem around the rim, leaving its center dark for a separate face portrait. Right end: a compact spear-shaped military crest mounting with black cloth and silver-white halo fragments, leaving a dark space for a separate SSS LIMITED DOM label. Ornament confined to the outer 200px on each side; middle must be clear. Intact panel silhouette, refined luxury military relic, restrained asymmetric spectral wisps at ends, visibly dimensional silver material, completely different from fantasy gold/blue frames. Keep top/bottom 50px transparent, all outer edges fully contained. No background, no floor, no text, letters, numbers, words, badges drawn as text, sword, dragon, animal, rainbow, gold, purple, blue or orange. High-end painted 2D game UI resource.
prompts.silver-tracer-v2:
Create a production-ready transparent 2D game VFX sprite sheet for Shiranui, a monochrome SSS limited military phantom rifleman. Use the attached existing effect sheet only for silver/black art direction; make a NEW clean atlas to improve the visibility of his very fast rifle bullets. Use-case: game-asset.
Canvas: landscape 2:1, exactly FOUR equally spaced columns by TWO rows of equal square cells. Every sprite stays entirely within the inner 75% of its cell with generous fully transparent gutters on all four sides. No marks or text, no grid, no backdrop.
TOP ROW: four animated phases of one right-facing, straight, elongated silver-metal rifle projectile. The nose points directly right and sits at 82% cell width, 50% cell height. The SOLID OPAQUE chrome silver bullet occupies from 48% to 82% cell width, with bold charcoal outline, bright ivory highlights, and visible black metallic collar grooves. Its central silhouette must be fully opaque, crisp, broad, and readable at tiny 40px sprite size. Behind it is a short sharp white lightning tracer from 18% to 55% cell width, with an opaque bright white central streak and subtle narrow silver wisps. Not a translucent smoke cloud. High contrast, silver bullet luminous but distinct from its tail. Four subtle changes to sparks/tracer shape, stable bullet geometry/position/size.
BOTTOM ROW: four corresponding short right-facing WAKE ONLY sprites. Thin, clean, tapered silver-white lightning streaks with dense white inner core and small dark-silver flecks from 18% to 82% cell width centered at 50% cell height. NO bullet head, no impact star or explosion. These are used as brief lingering trails behind a moving projectile. The wake should be compact, legible and not a large haze.
Quality: premium hand-painted 2D collectible RPG effects, clean metallic forms, exactly monochrome black charcoal silver white. Genuinely transparent background. Only outer glints can be translucent; silver metal and white tracer inner core must remain opaque. Do not include characters, guns, badges, UI frames or any content from the reference outside the requested 8 sprites. Keep every cell separate with large transparent margins; no streak may touch another cell or image edge.
